title: Benzer ilan kartlarındaki doğrulanmamış iddiaları kaldırma
description: Follow-up to the demo-detail cleanup. DemoIlanDetay renders related demo jobs with IlanKartı, which currently displays B3 verification and urgent badges plus a default ATS score and static ATS/AI recommendation panel that are not backed by live data. In the single assigned file, remove those unsupported signals and their now-unused props/imports/calculations. Preserve normal listing fields, salary/work details, localized save/share actions, and navigation. Do not alter APIs, schemas, dependencies, locales, or other files; do not commit.
acceptanceCriteria: Demo detail related-job cards no longer render B3-verified or urgent badges, an ATS percentage/gauge, or the associated generic ATS/AI recommendation panel; no fabricated company identifier is introduced; remaining actual listing fields and save/share/navigation controls remain; only the assigned card file changes; npm run kalite, npm run build, and git diff --check pass; no commit by OpenCode.
